description: Points for a Dutch rental home under the housing points system (woningwaarderingsstelsel, WWS) for independent homes, and the maximum legal basic rent: exactly the answer of our rent points calculator page, with the same inputs. Returns the total, the sector (social, middle-rent or free), the maximum rent and the points per category. Every input is optional and defaults to the page's own example.

bath_plus_shower.description: Bath plus separate shower in one bathroom (default 0)

bathroom_cupboard.description: Cupboard space in the bathroom of at least 40 by 40 cm (default false)

bathroom_meets_extras_requirements.description: The bathroom meets the requirements for extras (default true)

bathroom_single_lever_taps.description: Single-lever mixer taps in the bathroom (default 0)

bathroom_thermostatic_taps.description: Thermostatic mixer taps in the bathroom (default 0)

build_year.description: Build year, when energy_source is "year" (no valid label)

cooling_rooms.description: Rooms with fixed cooling that also heats: 0, 1 or 2 (2 or more)

double_washbasins_other.description: Other rooms or spaces with a double washbasin (default 0)

energy_label.description: Energy label A++++ to G (default C)

energy_performance_fee.description: An energy performance fee (EPV) is agreed (default false)

energy_source.description: label (default), ei (energy index) or year (no valid label: build year)

extra_cupboard_units.description: Extra kitchen cupboard units above the minimum, per 60 cm (default 0)

heated_open_kitchen.description: There is a heated open kitchen (default false)

home_type.description: apartment (homes above or below it, default) or house (single-family)

kitchen_appliances.description: Built-in kitchen extras present. Default: extractor_hood, fridge, electric_oven, single_lever_tap.

kitchen_basic_level.description: The kitchen meets the basic level (default true)

kitchen_countertop.description: Countertop length incl. sink and hob: under_1m, 1_to_2m or 2m_or_more (default)

newly_built_after_july_2024.description: First lived in after 1 July 2024, construction started before 2028 (default false)

official_check_extra_points.description: Points from the official Rent Check for anything not covered (default 0)

other_spaces.description: Other spaces (storage, attic, utility room) with area in m2; heated defaults to false. Default: one 4 m2 storage.

private_outdoor_m2.description: Private outdoor space in m2: garden, balcony, roof terrace (default 0)

rooms.description: Rooms (living room, bedrooms, kitchen, bathroom...) with their floor area in m2; heated defaults to true. Default: the page example 24, 11, 7 and 4 m2.

small_home_2018_2022.description: Under 40 m2, completed 2018 to 2022, COROP Amsterdam or Utrecht (default false)

toilets_separate_room.description: Toilets in a separate toilet room (default 1)

video_door_entry.description: Video and audio door entry (default false)

washbasins_other.description: Other rooms or spaces with a washbasin (default 0)

woz_valuation_date.description: 2025 (the WOZ letter of 2026, default), 2024, or none_use_legal_minimum

name: rent_points
title: Dutch rent points calculator (WWS)
